label: conj:c-from-color-flavor-swap
title: Charge conjugation $C$ as the color-sheet flavor-swap $u \leftrightarrow \bar u$, $d \leftrightarrow \bar d$
html:
Conjecture (charge conjugation as the color-sheet flavor swap; conditional on conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube). Within the QOU framework, charge conjugation C acts as the flavor swap on color sheets that exchanges each quark flavor with its antimatter-conjugate:

  C \;:\;
  \begin{cases}
    u \;\longleftrightarrow\; \bar u, \\
    d \;\longleftrightarrow\; \bar d,
  \end{cases}

applied independently to each of the three color sheets of every nucleon-coloured braid strand. The proton flavor triple (u, u, d) maps to (\bar u, \bar u, \bar d) (the antiproton); the neutron flavor triple (u, d, d) maps to (\bar u, \bar d, \bar d) (the antineutron). C is an involution (C^2 = \mathrm{id}) and commutes with the color-tube weighted averaging of conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube.

Separating C from the CPT composite

conj:cpt-orbit-closure-density formalises the composite CPT action. The framework historically collapses C, P, T into the single bar-involution def:bar-involution on Hecke generators (q \mapsto q^{-1} together with \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1}). That conflation suppresses the distinct categorical sources of the three discrete symmetries:

Symmetry Categorical source Acts on
C (this conjecture) flavor swap on color sheets quark-flavor content of nucleon braid strands
P mirror reflection of braid diagram writhe / signed-crossing classification (bar-involution-table3-data)
T Markov-trace word reversal trace-cyclicity dual

The bar-involution q \mapsto q^{-1}, \sigma_i \mapsto \sigma_i^{-1} acts as the composite CPT in this categorisation, not as C alone. This conjecture locates the C-component on the color sheets, orthogonal to P (braid-diagram mirror) and T (trace reversal).

The conjectural content

The proposition relies on the color-sheet flavor structure established in conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube. Specifically:

  1. C is well-defined. The flavor-content map (F_1, F_2) \mapsto (\bar F_1, \bar F_2) commutes with the color-tube weight tensor W_{c_1 c_2}(F_1, F_2)—i.e. W_{c_1 c_2}(\bar F_1, \bar F_2) = W_{c_1 c_2}(F_1, F_2) (the weights are flavor-conjugation invariant).
  2. C is an involution. Each color sheet flips back to its original flavor under two applications.
  3. C commutes with bar-involution on the algebraic side. This forces \mathrm{CP} \cdot \mathrm{T} and \mathrm{C} \cdot \mathrm{PT} to reduce to the bar-involution identity classified in bar-involution.md §Bar-symmetric.

When all three hold, C constitutes the well-defined Z/2 categorical symmetry on the color-sheet flavor data. The CPT composite of conj:cpt-orbit-closure-density factors as \mathrm{CPT} = C \cdot P \cdot T in the natural order, as three commuting Z/2 actions on the color-tube structure.

Structural position

  • GB filtration level. None: the claim addresses a Z/2 categorical symmetry on color-sheet metadata, not Hecke elements at a particular Coxeter length.
  • Jet order. h^0: the C-action is independent of q, and the flavor-conjugation map forms a structural Z/2 lifting through the color-tube tensor.
  • Bar-symmetry. C is bar-symmetric. It preserves q and commutes with \sigma_i \leftrightarrow \sigma_i^{-1}, since it acts on color-sheet labels and not on Hecke generators. It is C composed with PT that yields the bar-involution; C itself is bar-trivial in bar-involution-table4-data.

Lean axiomatisation (sketch)

-- Conditional on the color-tube channel-assignment class:
class CFromColorFlavorSwap
    (M : Type*) [BrCategory M] [ColorTube M]
    [InterNucleonChannelColorTube M] where
  /-- The Z/2 flavor-conjugation involution on color-sheet flavors. -/
  c_action : ColorSheetFlavor → ColorSheetFlavor
  /-- C^2 = id. -/
  c_involution : ∀ f, c_action (c_action f) = f
  /-- C commutes with the color-tube weight tensor (flavors are
      conjugation invariant). -/
  c_commutes_W :
    ∀ (F₁ F₂ : NucleonFlavorContent) (c₁ c₂ : ColorSheet),
      color_tube_weight (c_action F₁) (c_action F₂) c₁ c₂
        = color_tube_weight F₁ F₂ c₁ c₂
  /-- CPT factorisation: C · P · T = bar-involution. -/
  cpt_factorisation :
    bar_involution = c_action ∘ p_braid_mirror ∘ t_trace_reverse

The class becomes inhabited by the color-tube data once conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube is instantiated.

Consumers / downstream

  • conj:cpt-orbit-closure-density becomes a corollary of \mathrm{CPT} = C \cdot P \cdot T once the charge-conjugation, parity and time-reversal components close jointly—the content of conj:cpt-d6-d7-d8-closure.
  • The matter/antimatter sheet structure on Bring's quintic surface (def:color-tube-fibers) acquires a natural C-action that descends to the SO(3) fiber.
  • Type-B folding for chirality and CPT (conj:type-b-folding-cpt) is the symmetric-crystal analogue of this conjecture. Folding the \mathfrak{sl}_n Cartan datum to Type B realises C as a symmetric-crystal structure.

Numerical cross-check and open content

At the 50-digit substrate q_0, the flavor-conjugation involution leaves the color-tube weighted inter-nucleon Hecke generator invariant for all sixteen nucleon pairs drawn from \{p, n, \bar p, \bar n\}, in two two-dimensional Hecke representations (the diagonal eigenvalue model and a non-diagonal conjugate of it), with the \epsilon and W tables invariant cell by cell (verify_c_color_swap.py, verify-c-color-swap.witness.json). The check runs the uniform projection W = 1/9—the only realisation of W available while its closed form remains open—so it corroborates the derivation rather than testing the conjectural Bring-derived W. No parameter is fitted.

The statement is conjectural only for as long as conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube and the S_5 \leftrightarrow \mathrm{SO}(3) fiber-action class conj:s5-so3-fiber-action remain uninhabited; supplying both makes it unconditional.
